headline: Kostoulas Greeks Out A Winner For test31121
deck: test31121 beat test3 30-24, Kostoulas top-scoring on eight as the deadlocked tie finally broke
body:
A tie that sat at nil for so long ended with test31121 six clear, and Kostoulas carried it. His eight up top led every man on the page, and the two defenders behind him did the rest of the work: Ampadu six, Botman two. A back line that scores is a back line that wins ties.

test3 had the round's other standout in Pickford, seven from a goalkeeper and the sort of return that ought to anchor a week. It did not. Ndiaye's five was the only other outfield contribution worth the name; Emersonn, Gibbs-White and Gonzalo mustered two apiece and Grimes three, and that is not enough behind a single seven.

test31121's midfield offered nothing either, Berge on three, Ødegaard and Petrović on two, but they did not need it. The defenders and the forward had already settled it, and test3's forwards blanking short is what will sting.
